title: Ultra-Wide and Coming in 29, 30.5, and 32 Sizes: The Newmen Streem G.48 CS
content:
Newmen’s newest carbon wheelset pairs a wide 45mm rim with premium aero spokes, and commits to the next generation of gravel geometry with three distinct diameters.

Read the full article at Ultra-Wide and Coming in 29, 30.5, and 32 Sizes: The Newmen Streem G.48 CS on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
